title: TOEFL ITP Orchestrator - per-item provenance record
description: The record orchestrator.build_provenance_record() emits for one candidate, combining a short human-readable summary (spec section 11 example) with the full accepted_item / qa_audit split (spec section 12). This is the shape written into analysis/orchestrator_smoke_test.json, analysis/orchestrator_adversarial_test.json, and analysis/orchestrator_reject_path_test.json. Descriptive documentation; not enforced by a JSON Schema library at runtime (see accepted_item.schema.json note).

consensus.description: True iff state == ACCEPTED. For the full failed_conditions/disagreement_reasons detail, see qa_audit.consensus.

batch_slot.description: Slot requirements (primary_target/difficulty/correct_answer_position/vocabulary_domain[/tested_error_type/error_scope]) to hand to a fresh Generator call if this candidate is discarded or rejected (spec section 14).

accepted_item.description: See accepted_item.schema.json. Null unless state == ACCEPTED.
